alternatives.argument: Complete local derivation replaces reliance on the failed MIT fetch: put theta=aT/c. The hyperbolic identities give x1+x0=rho exp(theta) and x1-x0=rho exp(-theta), so rho>0 maps to x1>|x0|; the known Rindler inverse gives rho=sqrt(x1^2-x0^2) and T=(c/(2a)) log((x1+x0)/(x1-x0)). Differentiating x0=rho sinh(theta), x1=rho cosh(theta) and substituting the inertial metric yields ds^2=-(a rho/c)^2 dT^2+d rho^2+dy^2+dz^2. For fixed rho the clock postulate gives d tau/dT=a rho/c^2; proper-time differentiation yields U=(c cosh eta,c sinh eta), A=(c^2 sinh eta/rho,c^2 cosh eta/rho), and proper acceleration c^2/rho. Radial null motion obeys d rho/dT=±a rho/c, hence integrating d log(rho)/dT=±a/c gives the finite endpoint travel time; two stationary clocks over a common nonzero Delta T therefore have increment ratio rho_R/rho_E. For a radial plane phase kappa(x1-x0) or -kappa(x1+x0), its T derivative is constant along the associated null ray, while U=(c/(a rho)) partial_T; contraction with the defined observer-frequency functional gives omega_R/omega_E=rho_E/rho_R. This last ratio is only a functional identity; the physical accelerated-reception reading remains separately unresolved.

alternatives.argument: Complete independent proof supplied in the assigned theorem: with theta=aT/c the hyperbolic identities give x1+x0=rho exp(theta), x1-x0=rho exp(-theta), and the existing smooth Rindler inverse rescales to T. Differentiating the map yields the stated metric; its stationary proper-time line element gives d tau/dT=a rho/c^2. Proper-time differentiation gives U=(c cosh eta,c sinh eta) and A=(c^2 sinh eta/rho,c^2 cosh eta/rho), hence proper acceleration c^2/rho. The radial null metric equation gives d rho/dT=±a rho/c; integration of d log(rho)/dT gives the finite endpoint travel time. Clock increments on a common nonzero T interval therefore scale as rho. For an affine radial plane phase, the T derivative is constant along its null ray and U=(c/(a rho)) partial_T, so the defined contraction functional scales as 1/rho. This proves all chart, metric, proper-time, acceleration, ray and functional claims without relying on the unverified subsection; accelerated-reception interpretation remains excluded.
